## 🛠️ Type of Change
<!-- Please check the boxes that apply (e.g. [x]) -->
- [ ] **New Tool / Game Addition** (e.g. standalone app inside `/Applications`)
- [ ] **Bug Fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] **Feature Addition / Enhancement** (non-breaking change which adds or improves functionality)
- [ ] **Refactoring** (code structure improvements, cleanup, or optimizations)
- [ ] **Documentation Update** (updates to Markdown files, blogs, or guides)

---

## ✅ Checklist
<!-- Please check all boxes that apply before submitting. -->
- [ ] **Target Branch**: My PR targets the **`dev`** branch (PRs to `main` will be closed).
- [ ] **Local Verification**: I have run the workspace locally and verified that **`npm run build`** succeeds cleanly with no TypeScript, webpack, or compiler errors.
- [ ] **Zero Console Errors**: I have tested the changes in the browser and confirmed there are no console warnings or errors.
- [ ] **Responsive Design**: I have tested and verified that my changes are fully responsive and work seamlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
- [ ] **Design Rules**:
  - [ ] Emojis have **not** been used inside UI components (Font Awesome is used instead).
  - [ ] Layout is clean, accessible, and supports dark/light mode where applicable.
- [ ] **Package Lockfile**: I have avoided unnecessary modifications to `package-lock.json` (or I have provided an explanation below if changes were necessary).
- [ ] **Single Focus**: This PR contains changes focused on a **single issue/feature** only (no unrelated changes).

---
